supabase._comment: Rejected by default via disabledMcpjsonServers in .claude/settings.json. Enable when BMAD picks Supabase as the DB: drop it from that list and set SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN and SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF.

gortex._comment: Code-intelligence graph over this repo (replaces CodeGraphContext + GitNexus). Installed by mise (see mise.toml) and resolved through its shim on PATH, then indexed by postCreateCommand; bare `gortex` also resolves for host users who installed it themselves. Needs no credential and binds no port.
